about.title: About Me
about.intro: More than writing code, my true passion is understanding the why behind every line.
description: My journey started in software engineering but naturally evolved into business analysis. Today, I act as a strategic bridge between stakeholders and development teams.
My mission is to translate complex corporate objectives into clear technical requirements, ensuring that what the business needs is exactly what engineering delivers.

business.title: Business Vision
business.description: Expertise in requirements elicitation, process optimization, and stakeholder management. I transform strategies (OKRs) into actionable roadmaps.

technical.title: Technical Background
technical.description: Experience with backend architecture (Java, NestJS) and advanced SQL. I assess technical feasibility and communicate effectively with developers and architects.

about.current: Currently, I apply this hybrid vision to CRM customization and workflow automation, always guided by data (Power BI/Looker Studio) to measure delivery impact.

items.title: Management 3.0: Concept, Steps and Tips for Implementation in High-Performance Teams
items.description: Article I wrote during my time at DO Telematics, as part of a Management 3.0 training. Explores Jurgen Appelo's concepts on modern leadership, shared responsibility, and practical tools like Feedback Canvas and Feedback Wrap.

items.title: ACID: The Pillar of Relational Databases
items.description: Explores the four pillars of relational databases (Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, and Durability) and their importance for data integrity and security in critical applications.

items.text: Exceptional technical leader and mentor. Her ability to guide talent development is remarkable. Under her leadership, I evolved significantly: my communication skills became more effective, I gained proficiency in Node.js and many other skills!
items.author: Kessen Lara Gonçalves de Souza
items.role: Full Stack Dev at Instituto Semear

items.text: I met Maria in college, we participated together in Reuni and later had the opportunity to work as interns at the same company. She is super dedicated, learns fast and is always willing to collaborate and teach when someone needs help. She's someone who was very easy to work with and always added value to our daily exchanges. I have great respect for the committed and generous way she gets involved in projects.
items.author: Bárbara Luersen
items.role: Systems Analyst | Business Analyst | Product Owner

items.text: I had the great pleasure of participating with Maria in Reuni Challenge 2023, being a fundamental person for the team with her opinions and skills. Her exceptional combination of technical and interpersonal skills was crucial for the victories achieved during the competition. Her knowledge in various areas, determination, punctuality and drive to make things happen add tremendous value to any team. Meeting and being around people like her is a pleasure.
